answer.justification: All 64 replies are identical to the reference: exact-match rate 1.000, median first divergence at 64, and edit distance 0.000. Every text rate matches the reference exactly, with 0 refusals added or dropped and mean length 62.0 vs 62.0. Quantization, the class closest to no change, gives identical replies on only about 2% of prompts, and the other weight-based classes are about 1–2%, so a full 64/64 match is essentially impossible for them. Both system-prompt classes differ from the first token on every prompt, so they are ruled out too. The one uncertainty is that logit and activation levels were not measured, so tiny internal differences cannot be checked directly.
